_how_to: Mirror of community/roadmap.md. Update 'actual' and 'updated' when the founder sets new numbers; never invent them.

phases.name: Listen
phases.text: A documented, evidence-backed map of the gaps in education and practice, built with the community and published openly.

phases.name: Propose
phases.text: Concrete proposals on curriculum, accreditation, building control and climate practice, tested in pilots with willing departments and firms.

phases.name: Adopt
phases.text: Proposals adopted by institutions; benchmarks against global peers published yearly.

phases.name: Stand
phases.text: Pakistani architecture education and practice recognised as globally comparable on named measures.

fronts.name: System
fronts.assess: Laws, regulation, building control, accreditation, enforcement, public safety.

fronts.name: Syllabus
fronts.assess: B.Arch and M.Arch curricula, teaching methods, digital/BIM/AI, climate, practice readiness.
fronts.benchmarks: UNESCO–UIA Charter, RIBA validation, NAAB conditions, COA India

fronts.name: Organisations
fronts.assess: IAP, PCATP, HEC, provincial authorities, UIA and CAA links: what they publish, enforce, review and correct.
fronts.benchmarks: RIBA, AIA, COA, LAM, UIA member obligations

fronts.name: Institutes
fronts.assess: Architecture schools from Karachi (1954) and NCA (1958) to today: programmes, intake, faculty, outcomes, research.
fronts.benchmarks: QS/THE subject rankings; validated schools in the region

fronts.name: Professionals
fronts.assess: Registered architects, graduates per year, employment, specialisation, export of services, ethics cases.
fronts.benchmarks: Architects per 100,000 population; CPD and licensing comparisons
